note: Image and Media Delta Formatter provides field formatters that render only specific deltas of a multi-value image/media field. image_delta_formatter (Image delta, image fields) is a normal plugin; media_delta_formatter (Media delta) and responsive_image_delta_formatter (Responsive image delta) are registered conditionally via hook_field_formatter_info_alter() only when core media / responsive_image is enabled. Shared ImageDeltaTrait adds two settings: deltas (integer array, required) and deltas_reversed (bool). No config route, no permissions. Persistent state is the formatter type + settings.deltas on a field component in an entity_view_display config entity (e.g. core.entity_view_display.node.article.default -> content.<field>.type/settings.deltas). Medium reads back the configured formatter/deltas/reversed on a known field; hard switches an image field's display formatter to image_delta_formatter with specific deltas, verified live. Fixture fields are namespaced field_idf_* (multi-value image fields on Article).

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module image_delta_formatter lets you show only certain values of a multi-value image or media field. What are the field formatter plugin ids it provides, and which require the core media or responsive_image modules?
evals.expected_output: image_delta_formatter (Image delta, for image fields), media_delta_formatter (Media delta, for media entity_reference fields, only when core media is enabled), and responsive_image_delta_formatter (Responsive image delta, for image fields, only when responsive_image is enabled). The media/responsive ones are registered via hook_field_formatter_info_alter().

evals.prompt: When configuring the 'Image delta' formatter from image_delta_formatter, which two settings does it add, and how do I make it show only the first image of a multi-value field?
evals.expected_output: It adds deltas (a required comma-separated list of 0-based positions, e.g. '0') and deltas_reversed (a checkbox to count from the last value). To show only the first image, set the Delta to 0.

evals.prompt: There's no settings page for image_delta_formatter. Where do I configure it and where is the delta selection stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the entity bundle's Manage display page choose the Image/Media/Responsive image delta format and enter the deltas. It is stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type and settings.deltas.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value image field field_idf_gallery whose default display uses image_delta_formatter. Inspect the live view display and tell me which formatter is applied to field_idf_gallery and which deltas it is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: field_idf_gallery uses the image_delta_formatter formatter showing deltas 0 and 2 (settings.deltas = [0, 2]) in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a multi-value image field field_idf_promo using the image delta formatter. Inspect its live default display configuration: is the 'reversed' (deltas_reversed) option enabled for it?
evals.expected_output: Yes. field_idf_promo uses image_delta_formatter with deltas_reversed = true (settings.deltas = [0], deltas_reversed = true), so it shows the last image.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a multi-value image field field_idf_shots currently rendered with the core Image formatter. Using image_delta_formatter, change the default display so this field shows only its first image (delta 0). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_idf_shots component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type image_delta_formatter with settings.deltas = [0].

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a multi-value image field field_idf_lead rendered with the core Image formatter. Use image_delta_formatter to make its default display show only the first two images (deltas 0 and 1), and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_idf_lead component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type image_delta_formatter with settings.deltas = [0, 1].
